message.content: A great dessert to follow Korean fried chicken is **Mango Sticky Rice (Khao Niao Mamuang)**. The creamy coconut milk and sweet mango contrast nicely with the savory, spicy crunch of the chicken, while the sticky rice adds a comforting texture that balances the meal. If you prefer something lighter, a refreshing bowl of **shaved ice (bingsu)** topped with fresh fruit and condensed milk also works well—its coolness and sweetness cut through the richness of the fried chicken.
